_meta.description: Symbol database for multimodal content moderation. Edit this file to add/update symbols without changing code.

schema.name: human-readable display name
schema.keywords: list of fuzzy-match keywords — any hit scores a match
schema.description: what the model should look for visually
schema.confidence_required: 0.0–1.0: threshold above which the symbol is auto-flagged; below this it routes to human review
schema.route_to_human_below: if confidence is below this value, always route_to_human=true
schema.hit_count: Number of times human confirmed this symbol
schema.miss_count: Number of times human overturned a hit for this symbol
schema.is_learned: True if this symbol was auto-generated from feedback
